lessons.goal_uz: Narsalar qanday ishlab chiqarilishi va kim tomonidan yaratilgani haqida gapirasiz: Passive Voice (is made / was invented).

steps.title: A smartphone's journey
steps.text: Have you ever thought about where your phone comes from? Most smartphones are designed in one country, but they are made in many others. The screens are produced in South Korea or Japan, the batteries are often made in China, and the parts are put together in huge factories. Some phones are even assembled in Uzbekistan now. The software is developed by thousands of programmers around the world. When the phone is finished, it is tested, packed in a box and sent to shops. The first mobile phone was invented in 1973 — it weighed more than a kilo! Today, over a billion smartphones are sold every year.
steps.uz: Telefoningiz qayerdan kelganini hech o'ylab ko'rganmisiz? Ko'pchilik smartfonlar bir mamlakatda loyihalanadi, lekin boshqa ko'p mamlakatlarda yasaladi. Ekranlar Janubiy Koreya yoki Yaponiyada, batareyalar ko'pincha Xitoyda ishlab chiqariladi, qismlar esa ulkan zavodlarda yig'iladi. Ba'zi telefonlar hozir hatto O'zbekistonda ham yig'ilmoqda. Dasturiy ta'minot butun dunyodagi minglab dasturchilar tomonidan ishlab chiqiladi. Telefon tayyor bo'lgach, u sinovdan o'tkaziladi, qutiga joylanadi va do'konlarga jo'natiladi. Birinchi mobil telefon 1973-yilda ixtiro qilingan — uning og'irligi bir kilodan ortiq edi! Bugun har yili bir milliarddan ortiq smartfon sotiladi.

steps.body_uz:
Ish **kim** qilgani emas, **nima** bo'lgani muhim bo'lsa ishlatiladi. O'zbekchadagi **-il / -in** qo'shimchasiga o'xshaydi: yasaladi, ixtiro qilingan.
Tuzilma: **be + V3**.
Hozirgi: **is / are + V3** — Cars **are made** in Asaka.
O'tgan: **was / were + V3** — The phone **was invented** in 1973.
Kim qilgani kerak bo'lsa — **by**: The app was developed **by** students.
Aktiv → passiv: They **build** houses. → Houses **are built**.
Xato: "The car made in Japan" — **be** tushib qolgan! To'g'ri: The car **is / was** made in Japan.

steps.body_uz:
Birovning gapini yetkazganda zamon odatda **bir qadam orqaga** suriladi:
am/is → **was** · are → **were** · do/does → **did**
will → **would** · can → **could** · Past Simple → **had + V3** (yoki o'zgarmaydi)
"I **am** tired," he said. → He said (that) he **was** tired.
"We **will** call you." → They said they **would** call me.
Olmoshlar ham o'zgaradi: I → he/she, my → his/her.
**say** va **tell** farqi: **say** (something) — She **said** that... · **tell** + kishi — She **told me** that... ("She said me" — xato!)
Vaqt so'zlari: today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, now → then.

examples.en: "I live in Samarkand." → She said she lived in Samarkand.
"I can help you." → He told me he could help me.
examples.uz: U menga yordam bera olishini aytdi.

lessons.title: If I were the mayor...
lessons.goal_uz: Atrof-muhit muammolari haqida gapirasiz va xayoliy vaziyatlarni Second Conditional (If I had..., I would...) bilan ifodalaysiz.

words.ex: Air pollution is a big problem in big cities.

steps.title: A school debate
steps.context_uz: Maktabda "Shahrimizni qanday yashilroq qilamiz?" mavzusida bahs ketyapti.

lines.en: Imagine you were the mayor of Tashkent. What would you change?

steps.body_uz:
Hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi **haqiqiy bo'lmagan, xayoliy** vaziyat uchun (o'zbekcha: "...sa edi, ...rdi").
Tuzilma: **If + Past Simple, would + fe'l**.
If I **had** more money, I **would buy** an electric car. (Hozir pulim yo'q.)
**be** — barcha shaxslarda ko'pincha **were**: If I **were** you, I'd recycle more. If it **were** cheaper...
First Conditional bilan farqi: If it **rains**, I **will** stay home (haqiqiy imkoniyat). If I **won** the lottery, I **would** travel (xayol).
Xato: "If I would have money..." — **if** qismida **would** ishlatilmaydi!

examples.en: If I were you, I would take the bus.
examples.uz: Men sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, avtobusda ketardim.

examples.en: We wouldn't have droughts if we used water carefully.

steps.text: If public transport were better, people would drive less and the air would be cleaner.

steps.prompt_uz: "Agar siz shahringiz hokimi bo'lganingizda, ekologiyani yaxshilash uchun nima qilgan bo'lardingiz?" 6–8 gap yozing, Second Conditional ishlating.
steps.prompt: If you were the mayor of your city, what would you do to help the environment?
steps.example: If I were the mayor of my city, I would do three things to help the environment. First, I would plant trees along every main road, because the air would be cleaner and the streets would be cooler in summer. Second, I would make public transport cheaper. If buses were cheap and fast, fewer people would drive to work. Finally, I would put recycling bins in every neighbourhood. If people had easy ways to recycle, they wouldn't throw plastic in the street. I think these changes would make our city a healthier place to live.
